description:
Add three custom fields to Vicidial List ID 8501 ('US Senator Advocacy') to capture campaign-specific data.

Login to the Vicidial Admin interface (User: 6666, Pass: andromeda), navigate to the Lists section, select List 8501, and go to the Custom Fields menu. Add the following fields:

1. Policy Position
   - Field Name: policy_position
   - Label: Policy Position
   - Type: SELECT
   - Options: SUPPORTS, OPPOSES, UNDECIDED, NO_RESPONSE

2. Staff Contact Name
   - Field Name: staff_contact_name
   - Label: Staff Contact Name
   - Type: TEXT
   - Size: 50

3. Follow-up Date
   - Field Name: followup_date
   - Label: Follow-up Date
   - Type: DATE

Ensure all fields are active and the custom table is created.
